title: Why are European banks moving gold out of United States?
snippet: The Netherlands and France have moved their gold out of US vaults. Part of the reason is fears about the reliability of the US, but equally important is the need to keep gold closer to home in the event of a crisis.

title: Can Iran replace sea trade with land routes?

title: Africa's richest man Dangote's IPO out of reach in Nigeria

title: Spanish scientists find first evidence of Diplodocus dinosaur in Europe
